Follow-up: an extra attack fired outside your turn when a condition is met (e.g. an ally attacks). Usually a repeat of a basic attack at some % of its damage and effects, capped to a number of triggers per turn.

Often paired with a bonus damage hit on trigger.

Tenacity: a shield layer that absorbs damage, usually scaled off Max HP. The shield is multiplied by Shield Rate and is eaten BEFORE real HP (Shield → Extra HP → Armor → HP). An enemy's 'Shield Break' deals extra damage to a Tenacity-holding target.

Internal Injury: a delayed damage seed placed on a target that triggers WHEN the target attacks or is hit. It does no damage on application: it waits, then when the target is hit (or acts) it adds damage equal to a percentage of the caster's ATK, and disappears after triggering once. Several units can 'detonate' or absorb Internal Injury for extra burst.
